lines.zh: 水面亮了，我贴着浪尖游。
lines.en: The surface brightens; I swim along the wave crests.

lines.zh: 一摆尾，我就能滑出十米。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and I glide ten meters.
Fins spread, the wind holds me up.
Warm ocean water feels light to swim in.
I pick the pale blue water to travel.

lines.zh: 跃出去之前，先看浪的方向。
lines.en: Before leaping, I check which way the waves run.

lines.zh: 背上是蓝的，肚皮是银的。
lines.en: My back is blue, my belly silver.

lines.zh: 这条水道，我一天滑三趟。
lines.en: I glide this channel three times a day.

lines.zh: 水花小一点，海鸥就看不见。
lines.en: Keep the splash small so the gulls miss me.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流走，那里鱼多。
lines.en: I follow the warm current, where the fish are.

lines.zh: 跳出水面那一下，最快活。
lines.en: The moment I break the surface is the best part.

lines.zh: 鳍当翅膀用，落水也不疼。
lines.en: Fins serve as wings; hitting water does not hurt.
That shadow below belongs to a seal.
Dropping back in sounds like a clap.

lines.zh: 我跃出水面，滑过整条浪。
lines.en: I leap out and glide the whole wave.
I fold my fins before landing so it won't hurt.
One glide carries me far.
Fins out — I glide above the surface.
Pectoral fins spread, I glide a short way.
Fins open, I can glide far.
My scales throw back a patch of blue.
The sand below me slides away.
I swing around a rock.
I wander over these shallows.
I ride this current along.
The current is smoother than yesterday.
Pectorals out. Ready for takeoff.

lines.zh: 海豚一追，我就展开胸鳍。
lines.en: A dolphin chases, so I spread my fins.
When the wave lifts, I lift with it.
Two flicks of my tail and I shoot forward.
Seems I circled back to this water.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一拍，我贴着浪尖走。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I skim the wave crests.
Floating at the surface, letting the sun warm my back.
My tail sways lightly to hold my place.
Today my pattern is brighter than yesterday's.
I am waiting for a school of small fish.
The water below is too dark; I stay up.
Fins half folded, saving strength.
A dolphin calls somewhere far off.
I count the waves; there are seven.

lines.zh: 这片海的颜色，今天偏绿。
lines.en: The sea looks greener today.

lines.zh: 我停在水草边，装成一片叶子。
lines.en: I rest by the weeds, pretending to be a leaf.

lines.zh: 有只海豹在礁石上打盹。
lines.en: A seal is dozing on the rocks.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片会反光，很显眼。
lines.en: My scales catch the light and stand out.
The water is just right; I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 一群沙丁鱼过去了，太散。
lines.en: A school of sardines passed, too scattered.
The light on the water makes me sleepy.
I am counting waves, up to three.
I rest my tail fin on the weeds.

lines.zh: 珊瑚城上面，我数着水流。
lines.en: Above the coral city, I count the currents.
I am waiting for a small fish to pass.

lines.zh: 胸鳍一张，我又滑出去一段。
lines.en: Wings out, and I glide another stretch.
There is coral below, I know it.
I float just under the surface.
My side fins fan gently.

lines.zh: 海豚在追，我只能飞出去。
lines.en: Dolphins chase, so I fly out of the water.

lines.zh: 跃出水面那一下，风很凉。
lines.en: Breaking the surface, the air is cool.

lines.zh: 有点困，就贴着水眯一下。
lines.en: Sleepy; just a nap along the water.
I hold half a mouthful of water and stay still.
Wings out, I can glide a while.
You have stood on the shore a long while.

lines.zh: 你的影子落到水里，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow fell on the water; I noticed.

lines.zh: 你手里那个桶，我不喜欢。
lines.en: I do not like that bucket in your hand.
To catch me, you must jump in first.

lines.zh: 你的目光一直黏在我身上。
lines.en: Your gaze keeps sticking to me.
I leap because you are watching.

lines.zh: 你脚下的水很浅，我不过去。
lines.en: The water by your feet is shallow; I stay away.
No nets; my fins get tangled.

lines.zh: 你是不是也想去海上滑一段？
lines.en: Do you also want to glide over the sea?

lines.zh: 你的船划过来，我得让路。
lines.en: Your boat is coming; I should move aside.

lines.zh: 我跃出去，翅膀一样的鳍张开。
lines.en: I leap out and my wing-like fins spread.

lines.zh: 你在岸上蹲着，我猜你要撒网。
lines.en: You're crouched on the bank — I guess a net is coming.
I swim to your feet to have a look.
You took off your boots. Coming in?
I leap and glide quite far.
Your shadow has come down into the water.
Is that a net in your hand?

lines.zh: 水里你追不上，天上更不行。
lines.en: You cannot catch me in water, even less in air.
The waves have broken up your reflection.

lines.zh: 我跃出水面，你抬起了头。
lines.en: I leap from the water and you look up.

lines.zh: 鳍被咬掉一角，游起来偏。
lines.en: A bite took a corner of my fin; I swim crooked.
I flipped over in the water.
Scales came off, showing white beneath.
This blow sank me half a meter.
The pain made me leap out of the water.
Stop chasing; I cannot outswim you.
My lateral line is going numb.
Blood stained a small patch of water.

lines.zh: 我躲进礁石缝，喘一会儿。
lines.en: I hide in a crevice to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 翅膀似的鳍，现在抬不起来。
lines.en: My wing-like fins will not lift now.
I hit the water and flipped over.
I sank a stretch toward the bottom.
That blow left me dazed.

lines.zh: 我这胸鳍，能在空中滑一段。
lines.en: These pectoral fins can glide a fair way.
I rolled over before I steadied.
My side fin is torn open.
Something in the water bit me.

lines.zh: 海豚一来，我就跃出水面。
lines.en: The moment a dolphin comes, I leap out.

lines.zh: 胸鳍湿透了，我滑不起来。
lines.en: My pectoral fins are soaked; I cannot glide.

lines.zh: 侧线被划开了，我游歪了。
lines.en: My lateral line is cut — I'm swimming crooked.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎鱼，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the fish scraps you scattered.

lines.zh: 那点吃的，值得我靠近岸。
lines.en: That morsel is worth nearing the shore.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，看看有没有钩。
lines.en: I circle once to check for a hook.

lines.zh: 海面上的面包屑，也能凑合。
lines.en: Breadcrumbs on the surface will do.
If your hand twitches, I back off half a meter.
I smell shrimp nearby.
Toss another handful and I will leap over.
I am not greedy; one bite and I leave.

lines.zh: 食物旁边总有影子，我小心。
lines.en: There is always a shadow near food; I am careful.

lines.zh: 你不动，我才敢靠近一点。
lines.en: Only when you stay still dare I come closer.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，就让我跃出水面。
lines.en: Those few crumbs make me leap from the water.
Something is moving in your palm.

lines.zh: 谁撒了这么多，水面都在动。
lines.en: Who scattered this much? The surface is moving.
That's enough for one glide.

lines.zh: 这味儿顺着水钻进我的腮。
lines.en: That smell seeps through the water into my gills.
I hold my mouth open for the next bit.
A few crumbs are drifting over.
What did you scatter on the water?

lines.zh: 这比海草好吃多了，滑翔一下。
lines.en: Better than seagrass; let me glide a bit.
I can't help poking my head out.
Your hull scraped my fin.
A bump underwater is nothing.
You weigh far more than I do.
Do not step into the water; I am right here.
A wave pushed me against your leg.
After the bump I flick my tail and swim on.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水里，像块礁石。
lines.en: Your foot in the water feels like a rock.
I glide too fast to stop.
A scale came off; it does not matter.
Make way, I am about to ride a wave.

lines.zh: 我的胸鳍一张，就滑出去。
lines.en: My fins spread and I glide away.

lines.zh: 撞上你，我的气泡全碎了。
lines.en: I hit you, and all my bubbles burst.
One spread of my fins and I glide far.
Pardon me — don't block this current.
I hit the rocks and skidded off course.
When dolphins chase, I spread my fins and fly.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花四起。
lines.en: We collide and the water sprays up.
I had just finished gliding when I hit you.

lines.zh: 海豚和海豹都在等我出来。
lines.en: Dolphins and seals are waiting for me.
Your leg knocked my side fin.

lines.zh: 那一条的花纹，跟我很配。
lines.en: That one's pattern goes well with mine.
We swim side by side at the surface.

lines.zh: 一起跃出去，落水时分开。
lines.en: We leap together and split when we land.
The warm season is here; time to pair.
I circled her three times.
Two flying fish can glide farther.
She leaps higher than I do; I accept that.

lines.zh: 水花溅在一起，算是答应了。
lines.en: Our splashes met, which counts as a yes.
The eggs will hang beneath the floating weed.

lines.zh: 明年这片海，会有更多鳍。
lines.en: Next year this sea will have more fins.
We swim side by side just under the surface.
Out of the water — I found you.

lines.zh: 你的鳞光，我隔着水就看见。
lines.en: I spot the glint of your scales through the water.
We leap out and swim as a pair.
This season's wind, I follow only you.

lines.zh: 海豚追我，我就往空中躲。
lines.en: When dolphins chase, I escape into the air.

lines.zh: 跃出水面，再落回你身边。
lines.en: Leap out, then drop back beside you.

lines.zh: 跟我一起跃出水面，试试。
lines.en: Leap out of the water with me — try it.
The eggs go down in the warmer water.
Your scales shine a little brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 水面漂着一片果皮，我顶一下。
lines.en: A fruit peel floats by; I nudge it.

lines.zh: 这块塑料似的东西，咬不动。
lines.en: This plastic-like thing will not break.

lines.zh: 我叼住一根海草，拖了一段。
lines.en: I grabbed a strand of weed and dragged it.
The pebble sank and I cannot follow.

lines.zh: 有片羽毛落水，我推着玩。
lines.en: A feather landed; I push it around.

lines.zh: 我捡到的都是漂着的东西。
lines.en: Everything I find is floating.

lines.zh: 这条死小鱼，够我吃两口。
lines.en: This dead minnow is good for two bites.
I nudged a shell onto the reef.

lines.zh: 手里有东西，游起来就慢。
lines.en: Carrying something slows my swimming.
I let go and it sank.
I pin it with my fin.

lines.zh: 胸鳍一张，我就滑出水面。
lines.en: My pectorals spread and I glide off the surface.

lines.zh: 水面上有东西，我先叼住。
lines.en: Something on the surface; I grab it first.

lines.zh: 我跃出水面，滑得比你跑得远。
lines.en: I leap out and glide farther than you run.

lines.zh: 水上漂来的东西，我衔着。
lines.en: What floats by, I carry in my mouth.
A piece of rope drifts over the surface.
This little stone is bright.
I nudge it along with my mouth.
I pick up a strip of waterweed.
Fins spread, and I'm a kite.

lines.zh: 水下有群小虾，我盯上了。
lines.en: A swarm of shrimp below; I have my eye on them.

lines.zh: 那只海豚在靠近，我该走了。
lines.en: That dolphin is closing in; I should go.

lines.zh: 我看见一只海豹的影子。
lines.en: I see the shadow of a seal.
Small fish are turning belly-up ahead; perfect.

lines.zh: 这只螃蟹在浅水里，跑不掉。
lines.en: This crab in the shallows cannot escape.
I have locked onto the slowest one.
A bird overhead; I must dive.

lines.zh: 那群鱼慌了，说明有东西来。
lines.en: The school panicked, so something is coming.

lines.zh: 它比我的嘴还小，正好吞。
lines.en: It is smaller than my mouth; easy to swallow.

lines.zh: 我盯着的，其实是追我的东西。
lines.en: What I watch is actually what hunts me.
It has its back to me.
The surface just moved.
I tense up.
I see its tail.
Something is thrashing in the shallows.
I leap out and glide a while.

lines.zh: 跃出水面那一刻，就是现在。
lines.en: The moment I leave the water. Now.
Pectoral fins out. I am taking off.
The wave pushed it right to me.
That one's worth a chase.
I lower myself and skim toward it.
When it turns, I change course.

lines.zh: 我数着它的尾摆，找空档。
lines.en: I count its tail beats to find a gap.
The glare hides me from it.

lines.zh: 差一点，我的鳍碰到它了。
lines.en: Almost; my fin touched it.

lines.zh: 它往礁石缝里钻，我跟进去。
lines.en: It slips into a crevice; I follow.
I stay still and wait for it to relax.
Chasing this long has tired me.
It sped up; I spread my fins too.
Now, I dart forward.
My pectoral fins open like wings.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Every time it moves, I gain an inch.
I circle underneath it.

lines.zh: 我从水面跃出去，能滑很远。
lines.en: I leap from the surface and glide far.
One leap carries me over the whole swell.
One flick of my tail and I'm on it.

lines.zh: 海豹一追，我就飞出水面。
lines.en: A seal chases, and I take to the air.
I close in, keeping the splash down.

lines.zh: 胸鳍张开，我能滑过整片海面。
lines.en: Pectorals spread, I can glide across the sea.
It won't escape into the weeds.
I bit once and it tore free.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，只能咬软的地方。
lines.en: My teeth are small; I bite only soft parts.
This bite landed by the gill.
Its tail struck me; I backed off.
After biting I glide away, no tussle.
My mouth is too small for a deep bite.
Once blood spreads, the water changes taste.
It is faster; I only got scales.
This bite will sting it for a while.
I missed and splashed back down.
It rolled over, and I let go.
When dolphins chase, I fly.
The hit throws up a sheet of water.
I ram it head-on.
I bite into its flank.

lines.zh: 这一记是从水面滑过来的。
lines.en: This one came gliding off the water.
My tail fin slaps it once.

lines.zh: 水面上滑一圈，我就回来。
lines.en: One glide over the surface and I come back.
One flap of my pectoral, one hit.
One glide, dozens of blocks. Watch.

lines.zh: 我在暖海的浅处睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the warm shallows.
The first mouthful of water is salty.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，鳍还是褶的。
lines.en: I hatched with my fins still folded.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，晃得我发晕。
lines.en: The light on the surface makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 一群同伴已经在滑翔了。
lines.en: A school of my kin is already gliding.

lines.zh: 我出生在珊瑚边的暖流里。
lines.en: I was born in a warm current by the coral.
This sea has no winter; that suits me.

lines.zh: 我第一次跃出水面，摔了回去。
lines.en: My first leap ended in a fall.
The waves above me are ten times my size.

lines.zh: 我认得了这片蓝，就算是家。
lines.en: I know this blue now; it counts as home.

lines.zh: 第一口海水，呛得我甩头。
lines.en: My first mouthful of seawater makes me shake my head.
I drop into these waters.
I spent a long time in the egg.
The water here is warmer than home.
A flip in the waves — no one around.
The wind off the surface reaches me.
A wave pushed me onto the shallows.
I rise from the bottom.
I hear the sea far off.
I spread my pectoral fins for the first time.

lines.zh: 水是凉的，火却烧到我的背。
lines.en: The water is cool, yet fire reached my back.

lines.zh: 水面上都是火，我往下沉。
lines.en: The surface is on fire; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 摔在礁石上，比落水疼多了。
lines.en: Hitting rock hurts far more than water.
I fell from way up there.

lines.zh: 我在水里，却像被闷住了。
lines.en: I am in water, yet I feel smothered.

lines.zh: 这里的水太稠，我喘不上。
lines.en: The water here is too thick; I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出水面老高。
lines.en: The blast threw me high above the surface.
The blast wave threw me clear.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿水而来，擦过我的尾。
lines.en: An arrow cut through the water past my tail.
My fin is pierced — I can't glide.

lines.zh: 这股力量，让我的鳍僵住。
lines.en: This force stiffens my fins.

lines.zh: 法术打过来，我滑不动了。
lines.en: The spell hit and I can no longer glide.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，滑不远了。
lines.en: Two days without food and I cannot glide far.
I can't find anything to eat down here.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the surface and numbed me whole.
The current crawls up through my scales.

lines.zh: 水没了，我在空气里乱摆。
lines.en: The water is gone; I thrash in empty air.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我滑不动了。
lines.en: No water in the void; I can't glide.
